comparators: one-sided one-sample t-test on species-specific rho values

design.fixed_effect_model: species-specific intercepts profiled out; common nonnegative within-species local-position slope; one-sided 0.5*chi-square_1 profile-LRT

interpretation.supported: A species fixed-intercept logistic model with a common within-species slope is substantially more powerful than the nonparametric species-conditioned omnibus for the correctly specified binary-logistic data-generating process, while showing approximately nominal average null rejection across the six null cells. The matched-null omnibus remains better calibrated in the worst null cell and makes fewer trait-model assumptions.
not_supported: the fixed-effect logistic comparator is universally superior
profile-LRT calibration is guaranteed under arbitrary sparse or separated species data
the matched-null omnibus is inefficient for non-binary or misspecified traits
model-based and permutation-based methods target identical estimands in all settings
